'''Wu Weihua''' ({{lang-zh|s=武维华|p=Wǔ Wéihuá}}; born September 1956) is a Chinese politician, professor, and scientist who is a [[Vice Chairperson of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress|Vice Chair]] of the [[Standing Committee of the National People's Congress]] in the [[14th National People's Congress]] and chair of the [[Jiusan Society]]. He works in the fields of [[Cell physiology|plant cell physiology]] and [[molecular biology]] and is a professor at [[China Agricultural University]].

==Early life==
Wu Weihua was born in [[Linfen]], China, on 6 September 1956.{{sfn|Hong Kong-related Designations|2020}} He is [[Han Chinese]].{{sfn|Government of China}} He graduated from [[Shanxi University]] after attending from 1978 to 1982, the Shanghai Institute of Plant Physiology with a [[master's degree]] after attending from 1982 to 1984, and [[Rutgers University]] with a [[doctorate]] after attending from 1989 to 1991. He conducted postdoctoral research at [[Harvard University]] from 1991 to 1993.{{sfn|Chinese Academy of Sciences}}{{sfn|Jiusan Society}}

==Career==
===Academic===
Wu was elected as a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2007. He has worked in the fields of [[Cell physiology|plant cell physiology]] and [[molecular biology]].{{sfn|Chinese Academy of Sciences}} He lectured at [[China Agricultural University]] from 1984 to 1987,{{sfn|Jiusan Society}} and has been professor there since 1994.{{sfn|Government of China}}{{sfn|Chinese Academy of Sciences}}{{sfn|Jiusan Society}} He was dean of the College of Life Sciences at China Agricultural University.{{sfn|Jiusan Society}}

===Politics===
From 2011 to 2012, Wu was deputy director of the Beijing Municipal Rural Work Committee.{{sfn|Jiusan Society}}

Wu joined the [[Jiusan Society]] (JS) in 2010. He was a member of the JS's 12th Central Committee, vice chair of its 13th Central Committee, and chair of its 14th Central Committee.{{sfn|Jiusan Society}} He was [[Vice Chairperson of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress|Vice Chair]] of the [[Standing Committee of the National People's Congress]] in the [[14th National People's Congress]].{{sfn|Government of China}} He attended the inauguration of Argentine President [[Javier Milei]] on 10 December 2023.{{sfn|National People's Congress|2023}}

On 7 December 2020, pursuant to [[Executive Order 13936]], the [[United States Department of the Treasury]] imposed sanctions on all 14 Vice Chairpersons of the National People's Congress, including Wu, for "undermining Hong Kong's autonomy and restricting the freedom of expression or assembly."{{sfn|Hong Kong-related Designations|2020}}
